title: !MSA at AraHealthQA 2025 Shared Task: Enhancing LLM Performance for Arabic Clinical Question Answering through Prompt Engineering and Ensemble Learning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating zero-shot and few-shot classification accuracy on multiple-choice Arabic medical questions that are specifically injected with cognitive biases (confirmation, recency, and status quo) as part of the MedArabiQ benchmark.
Evaluating classification accuracy on culturally sensitive or culturally biased multiple-choice Arabic medical questions within the AraHealthQA-2025 shared task.
